tasks.short: Coach caregivers on the ward and record the growth goal.

steps.what: Open the caregiver's last development note
Provide coaching and mentoring to caregivers
Agree the professional growth goal in the room
Record the coaching note after the session

tasks.design: The staff identifier opens the last development note in {TALENT}, which is what shortens the search through old folders. Providing coaching and mentoring, and agreeing the professional growth goal, stay in the room and are not recorded. Afterwards the specialist records skill, what was practised, the next practice and a review date in fixed fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last note sat in a folder the specialist had to hunt, and whether a caregiver can use the feedback is a judgement in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: The staff identifier can open the last development note the previous coach already stored. The conversation needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: Reading whether this caregiver can hear the feedback and can practise the goal on this ward.
tasks.human_edge: Only the specialist in the room can tell whether the goal is one this caregiver can practise.
tasks.altitude: The conversation is unchanged. Before it, the specialist sees the last goal. Nothing about who may judge the caregiver changes.

reach.task: Practise the skill named in the coaching note
reach.learn: Which next practice the specialist wrote, and whether the last note was empty

reach.task: Give the caregiver time to practise the goal
reach.learn: Which goal cannot be practised on this shift

evidence.claim: Recording how staff work needs works-council consent. This design does not record the coaching session.
Whether a caregiver can hear feedback and practise a goal on this ward is a judgement in the room. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Coaching and agreeing the growth goal are unchanged and stay at full time. The room is not recorded.

Opening the note is shorter only because the staff identifier opens the last development note. The specialist still reads it. Fields: staff id, skill name, last practice date, what was seen, next practice, review date. Producer: the previous coach, often this specialist. If this is the first session and the note is empty, the specialist starts from a blank field list inside this step.
If the identifier fails, the specialist searches by name inside the same opening step.
The record step is shorter only because those fixed fields replace a blank narrative page. That step is the capture of the next development note.
unknowns: Whether this ward already stores development notes against a staff identifier.
Which skill names the ward uses.
research_questions: How often the specialist opens the last note before a corridor coaching moment?

already_counted.description: Read the opened development note, and start from a blank field list when it is the first session.
Type the skill, the practice, the next practice and the review date after the session.

incremental.description: Rename a skill field when the ward changes the skill list, about twice a year, spread across 100 coaching hours.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A corridor coaching moment where nobody opens the last note and nobody writes the fields afterwards. The conversation and the growth goal stay the whole task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor the condition view, evaluate the patient, and write the note.

steps.what: Monitor medical conditions of the listed patients
Evaluate the patient's condition at the bedside
Discuss health conditions in collaboration with professionals
Record the evaluation of the watched conditions

tasks.design: The patient identifier opens one view in the {OTHER} patient record of vitals the ward nurse confirmed, labs the laboratory confirmed, and the last evaluation note, which is what shortens opening three places. Evaluating the condition at the bedside, and the discussion with other professionals, stay with the specialist and are not decided by the view. The evaluation note then uses fixed fields for the condition, what changed, the watch point and who was told.
tasks.previous_blocker: Vitals, labs and the last note lived in three places, and the condition is a judgement at the bedside.
tasks.enabler_now: Those three feeds are already stored against the patient. Putting them on one view needs no model, and the view does not name the condition.
tasks.still_hard: A change in colour, breathing or what the patient will not say, which the view does not hold.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides what the condition is from the bedside, not from the view.

ambition.what: Whether the latest vitals, labs and last evaluation were on the view before the bedside judgement, including for a stable patient.

tasks.altitude: The specialist still evaluates every patient at the bedside and still discusses the condition with colleagues. The view is open before they walk in. They gain no right to let the view decide.

reach.task: Confirm the vital the view is missing
reach.learn: Which vital type, value and time the specialist could not see

reach.task: Hear the bedside evaluation on the round
reach.learn: Which watch point the specialist wrote, and who was told

evidence.claim: A decision based solely on automated processing that has a legal or similarly significant effect needs a basis. Judging this patient's condition stays with the specialist. The view does not decide.
Matching a vital, a lab and what the specialist sees at the bedside is clinical judgement. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The bedside evaluation and the discussion with other professionals are unchanged and stay at full time. No model names the condition.

The view is shorter only because three already recorded feeds sit on one screen. Vital fields: type, value, unit, time. Producer: the ward nurse who confirmed them. Lab fields: test name, value, unit, time. Producer: the laboratory. Last evaluation fields: condition, what changed, watch point, who was told. Producer: the specialist who last wrote the note. The patient identifier comes from the ward list.
If a vital is missing, the specialist asks the ward nurse inside the view step. That ask stays inside this step's remaining time.
The note is shorter only because fixed fields replace a free paragraph. The specialist types the condition. Those fields are what the next round reads.
unknowns: Which vitals this ward confirms on every shift.
Whether labs return against the same patient identifier the ward list uses.
research_questions: How often a vital the specialist needs is missing from the record at the start of the round?

already_counted.description: Read the view and ask the ward nurse when a vital is missing.
Type the condition, what changed, the watch point and who was told.

incremental.description: Add or drop a result type on the view when the ward changes what it records.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A stable patient the specialist already knows. The view is only glanced at. The bedside evaluation and the discussion are almost the whole task, and a missing vital is asked in person.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess, test, diagnose and confirm the prescription after interaction flags.

steps.what: Open the chart before the health assessment
Perform comprehensive health assessments in the room
Conduct specialized tests the assessment requires
Record specialized tests in fixed result fields
Read the page for these differential diagnoses
Name the differential diagnoses for this patient
Choose medications or treatments for this patient
Flag interactions before prescribing these medications
Confirm the prescription after the interaction flags

tasks.design: The visit identifier opens the {OTHER} patient record, including the last note, the allergy list and the chief complaint written by the last clinician. The assessment, the specialized test, the naming of the differential diagnoses and the choice of medication stay with the specialist; the test result is typed as test name, value and unit, and the chief complaint opens the protocol page in {DOCS}, which the specialist still reads. Before storage, a rule file from the medicines-information body shows interaction pairs against the current medication list from the last prescriber, and the specialist confirms drug, dose, route and frequency.
tasks.previous_blocker: The chart, the protocol and the interaction chapter were separate hunts, and the diagnosis and the prescription are judgements a rule must not make.
tasks.enabler_now: The visit identifier can open the chart, the chief complaint can open the protocol page, and a maintained rule file can show drug pairs. Naming the diagnosis and confirming the prescription stay with the specialist.
tasks.still_hard: A presentation that fits two pages, a test the protocol does not mention, and a medicine the current list has wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist names the differential diagnoses and confirms the prescription. A page and a pair list do not.

ambition.what: Whether the interaction flags were on screen before the prescription is stored, on a repeat medicine as well as a new one.

tasks.altitude: The specialist still assesses, still does the test, still names the differential diagnoses, still chooses the medication and still confirms the prescription. The chart and the protocol page are open beside those acts. They gain no right to let a model diagnose or release a prescription.

reach.task: Review a differential the specialist could not close
reach.learn: Which protocol page was open, and which test result was typed

reach.task: See the stored prescription when a person sends it by today's means
reach.learn: Which interaction flag was on screen at confirmation

evidence.claim: A national medicine file checks interactions, contraindications, doses and duplicates. Here the step only shows interaction pairs for the drug the specialist already chose.

The inspector holds the provider responsible for careful use of generative tools and names medication errors from a wrong registration. The specialist confirms the drug against the current list before storage.
The cited medicines law defines a prescription. The text stored here is the one the specialist confirmed. A draft does not prescribe.
Naming the differential diagnoses and choosing the medication stay with the specialist in the visit. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The health assessment, the specialized test, naming the differential diagnoses, choosing the medication and confirming the prescription are unchanged and stay at full time. No model names the diagnosis.

Opening the chart is shorter only because the visit identifier opens the last note, the allergy list and the chief complaint. The specialist still reads them. Chart fields: patient id, last note date, allergy list, chief complaint. Producer of the note, allergies and complaint: the last clinician. Producer of the visit identifier: the booking clerk. If the link fails, the specialist searches by name inside this step.

The result step is shorter only because fixed fields replace a sentence in the progress note. Fields the specialist types after the test: test name, value, unit, time. That typing is the capture. Producer: this specialist, in this step. The test itself is not shortened.

Reading the page is shorter only because the chief complaint already on the chart opens the protocol page. The specialist still reads it. Page fields: complaint name, page id, paragraph id, paragraph text, review date. Producer: the protocol owner. If the complaint is empty, the specialist types the complaint name inside this step. If no page exists, this step is today's binder lookup.

The flag step is shorter only because the rule file shows matching pairs rather than the whole chapter. It is a review, not a zero-time machine step. Current medication list fields: drug, dose, start date, status. Producer: the last prescriber. If the list is empty, the specialist types it inside this step. Rule fields: drug pair, severity, message. Producer: the medicines-information body. If the file is missing, the step shows no flags and the specialist uses today's reference text inside this step. A model does not read free-text indications.

The specialist writes drug, dose, route and frequency on screen and then confirms that same text. The approval binds the text then on screen, including the flags from the previous step. A later edit voids it. The design does not send the prescription to a pharmacy.
unknowns: Whether this service's record already opens from the visit identifier.
Which interaction file the pharmacy already maintains.
Whether a later step, outside this task, is what sends the stored prescription.
research_questions: On a familiar follow-up, how often is there a specialized test beyond the assessment, and how often is a protocol page opened?

already_counted.description: Read the opened chart and reselect when the visit points at the wrong patient.
Type test name, value, unit and time after the test.
Read the opened protocol page, or type the complaint name when the chart has none.
Read the interaction flags, and type the current medication list when it is empty.
Write drug, dose, route and frequency and confirm that text.

incremental.description: Report a protocol link that fails to open so it can be pointed at the current complaint name.

approvals.approved_version: Prescription on screen at confirmation: drug, dose, route and frequency chosen in s7, plus the interaction flags from s8.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A familiar follow-up with no specialized test beyond the assessment, no protocol page opened, and a repeat prescription the specialist already knows. Opening the chart is the only shorter step. Assessment, diagnosis, choice and confirmation stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design an evaluation program from cited measures and confirm it.

steps.what: Design from quality measures of nursing practice
Decide how effectiveness of nursing practice is judged
Draft evaluation programs for organizational systems

loop.input: The questions named in the previous step, the measure rows, and the standard paragraphs.
loop.output: A draft sentence that cites a question id, a measure id, or a paragraph id.
loop.check: The sentence's claim is supported by the cited paragraph or by the measure definition, not only by the presence of an id.
loop.stop: Stop when a sentence has no citation, or adds a target the paragraph does not contain, or the paragraph file is missing. The specialist then writes the program in the confirmation step.
loop.why_not_simpler: The program is free text. A field copy cannot tell whether a sentence adds a target.

steps.what: Confirm the evaluation program on nursing quality

tasks.design: A measure list in {SPREADSHEET} shows counts the quality officer already stored, which is what shortens hunting old reports. The specialist still names which questions judge effectiveness, and a draft in {DOCS} may only use those questions, those counts and standard paragraphs, with each sentence citing the paragraph or the measure definition. The specialist confirms the evaluation program in the meeting, and writes it there if the draft adds a target the paragraph does not contain.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counts sat in old reports, and a program sentence can set a target the cited paragraph does not contain.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored counts can sit on one list, and a draft can be held to the paragraph it cites. The specialist still names the questions and still confirms the program.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing which question is worth asking, and rejecting a sentence that sounds right but changes the target.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides which question the program asks, and rejects a sentence the cited paragraph does not support.

ambition.what: Whether each program sentence cites a measure or a standard paragraph before the meeting confirms it.

tasks.altitude: The specialist still decides what the evaluation program asks and still confirms it in the meeting. Each sentence they accept is tied to a measure or a paragraph. They gain no right to accept a sentence the paragraph does not contain.

reach.task: Supply the measure count the program cites
reach.learn: Which measure had no feed and was typed by hand

reach.task: Keep the standard paragraph the draft cites
reach.learn: Which sentence was rejected because the paragraph did not contain the target

evidence.claim: The inspector holds the provider responsible for careful use of generative tools. The specialist rejects a program sentence that adds a target the cited paragraph does not contain.
A program sentence is usable when it cites a measure definition or a standard paragraph the committee already approved. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Naming the questions and confirming the program in the meeting are unchanged and stay at full time.

The measure step is shorter only because a list shows stored counts instead of a hunt through old reports. The specialist still reads the rows. Fields: measure id, period, count, source note. Producer: the quality officer. If a count is missing, the specialist types it inside this step. That typing is the capture. There is no zero-time pull of a count nobody stored.

The draft is shorter only because each sentence must cite a question, a measure or a paragraph, so the specialist edits a cited text instead of a blank page. Paragraph fields: paragraph id, paragraph text, review date. Producer: the protocol committee, as a maintained file, not a step in this task. If the file is missing, the draft stops and the specialist writes the program in the meeting.

If the draft is rejected, the specialist writes the program text at the start of the meeting and then confirms that text. The approval binds the text then on screen: the questions named earlier, the measure rows cited, and any edit made in the meeting.
unknowns: Which measures the quality officer already stores as a count.
Whether the protocol committee's paragraphs cover organizational systems as well as bedside practice.
research_questions: How often a measure the program needs has no stored count and must be typed by hand?

already_counted.description: Read the measure rows and type a count the feed does not hold.
Read each drafted sentence against the cited paragraph or measure definition.
Confirm the program in the meeting, or write it there when the draft is rejected.

incremental.description: Update the measure list when the quality officer retires a measure.

approvals.approved_version: Evaluation program on screen at confirmation: the questions named in s2, the measure rows cited, and any edit made in the meeting.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A small program the specialist has written before. Measure feeds are missing, so counts are typed by hand. The draft is rejected and the specialist writes the program in the meeting. The decision and the meeting stay the whole task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still coaches in the room, evaluates the patient, names the diagnosis, chooses the medication and decides what the evaluation program asks. Before those acts they can see the last goal, the latest results and the open protocol. No right passes to a model to diagnose, prescribe or judge a caregiver.
reach: Ward nurse: which vital was missing from the view, and the last coaching goal.
Physician: which differential was named and which protocol page was open.
Pharmacist: which interaction flag was on screen when the prescription was stored. The order stays in the record until a person sends it by today's means.
Quality officer: which measure had no feed and was typed by hand.
skills_to_grow: Reject a growth goal the caregiver cannot practise on this ward.
Reject a diagnosis the open protocol page does not support.
Reject a program sentence that sets a target the cited paragraph does not contain.
role.ambitious_version: On a ward round the specialist sees whether the last coaching goal, the latest vitals and the open protocol still agree before the prescription is stored. Once a quarter the evaluation program is a decision about which question is worth asking, with each sentence tied to a measure or a standard paragraph. The specialist still decides.
